# orchestra_environments (Data Source)

Environments in the workspace. The list endpoint omits environment values; use the `orchestra_environment` data source to read those for one environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orchestra_environments" "all" {}

output "default_environment" {
  value = one([for e in data.orchestra_environments.all.environments : e.name if e.default_env])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) All environments in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Account the environment belongs to.
- `allow_unpublished_pipelines` (Boolean) Whether unpublished pipelines may run against this environment.
- `allowed_branches` (List of String) Branches allowed to run against this environment.
- `default_env` (Boolean) Whether this is the default environment.
- `id` (String) The environment ID.
- `name` (String) Environment name.
